phase: authoring (R87 survival cores for the eleven stages without one)
status: authored, NOT applied - the apply is a separate DB-writer unit

method.order: 1. select a real sentence already in corpus/sentences/bank.json; 2. otherwise mine a real Tatoeba sentence out of raw_tatoeba_sentence (248,705 rows, CC-BY, already licensed and ingested) that the bank does not yet hold; 3. only if neither exists, author the frame (spec 1.2, selection over generation).
method.filters: register in ('neutral','polite') per the W31 derivation; punctuation-stripped length <= 20; exactly one communicative function; not already a say_now phrase; R86 (punctuation-normalised jp) unique path-wide and inside this table.
method.known_set: KNOWN(stage) is the cumulative `words` of course/speak stages 1..N as shipped. Every row is proved on three counters: `unknown_vocab` = content lemmas with NO corpus/vocab record (hard gate, must be 0, else the learner meets a word that cannot be introduced, glossed or turned into an SRS card); `new_at_stage_start` = vocab not yet known when the stage opens (must be <= MAX_NEW = 3, the builder's i+1 budget, since an R87 phrase still passes it); `outside_stage_known_set` = the words the stage must additionally introduce once the row leads it.
method.vocab_resolution: bank rows use the committed export dissection; mined and authored rows use SudachiPy(dict=full, split mode C) and resolve a content lemma against corpus/vocab by headword, any `forms[].form`, or kana. Particles, auxiliaries, punctuation and numerals are not content.
method.register: reused from research/derived/pending/sentence_register_derived.json for bank rows; recomputed for mined and authored rows by importing scripts/derive_sentence_register_v2.py::decide (same predicate, same precedence, same D7 value set), so the values are comparable.
method.generated_rows: jp drops the final 。; slug is gen-<sha1(jp)[:12]>; tatoeba_id is empty; ai_generated and needs_review are true; D10 caps them at one per unit of six, and this table holds at most one per stage.
method.byte_fidelity: mined jp is copied verbatim from raw_tatoeba_sentence.text and the English from raw_tatoeba_translation.text for the same jp_id; a row whose English is not byte-identical to a stored translation is refused rather than paraphrased.
method.how_to_refute_a_row: re-run the three known-set counters from the export; re-derive the register with scripts/derive_sentence_register_v2.py; check jp and en against the raw tables by id; check the R86 normalisation against course/speak; check that the pt-BR reads as the named function and as one act only.

source.raw_pool: db/corpus.sqlite raw_tatoeba_sentence (248,705) + raw_tatoeba_translation (285,215), read from a scratch COPY, never written
